doc_name: 国务院关于印发鼓励软件产业和集成电路产业发展若干政策的通知（国发〔2000〕18号）
quote_zh: 国家鼓励在我国境内开发生产软件产品
quote_en: The state encourages the development and production of software products within China.
notes: Dedicated policy document (tax, finance, export, procurement, talent chapters). Also: 加快软件产业和集成电路产业发展，是一项紧迫而长期的任务. IP-enforcement wording (严厉查处盗版) is not an industry restriction.

doc_name: 国务院关于印发鼓励软件产业和集成电路产业发展若干政策的通知（国发〔2000〕18号）
quote_zh: 鼓励境内外企业在中国境内设立合资和独资的集成电路生产企业
quote_en: Domestic and foreign firms are encouraged to set up joint-venture and wholly-owned IC manufacturers in China.
notes: Dedicated chapter 12 (tax rebate on VAT above 6%, equipment tax breaks, 3-year depreciation). IC design is treated as software (集成电路设计业视同软件产业).
